<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>Method not found: no running connector handles &#x27;…&#x27;</span></div>

<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>connector not running</span></div>

## Why it happens

The method name in the widget or request does not match any key in a connector's RPC section, or the connector that has it is stopped.

## Fix it

Add the key to the connector's RPC section (you can create it from a read key), check the method name, and start the connector.

## Check that it worked

The write returns a result.
